posts.title: I noticed a lot of people drew Coco as an adult looking like Qiffrey, with the same outfit and even…
posts.description: I noticed a lot of people drew Coco as an adult looking like Qiffrey, with the same outfit and even same glasses, I didn’t understand why and people explained me it was most likely because of a doodle from Shirahama. But I think I would prefer Coco with a personal design, her own color and magic basically ! So I tried to make her an adult design ❤️
